strings.Algunas rutas pueden integrar recogidas: Some routes can integrate light and safe waste collections without turning the activity into an improvised intervention.
strings.Briefing ambiental, ritmo controlado, se: Environmental briefing, controlled pace, respected trails, reduced noise and remote observation.
strings.El territorio no es un decorado: The territory is not a decoration
strings.Entradas, fondeos, aleteos y recorridos: Entries, anchoring, finning and routes are planned so as not to damage meadows, seabeds or coastal communities.
strings.Grupos adecuados, material preparado, re: Appropriate groups, prepared material, returned waste and use of paths, accesses and permitted areas.
strings.Interpretar ramblas, viento, erosión, bi: Interpreting boulevards, wind, erosion, biodiversity and human footprints turns the environment into a natural classroom.
strings.La saturación del lugar puede obligar a: Saturation of the place may force you to change the schedule, reduce the group or choose an alternative.
strings.Material duradero, reparable y compartid: Durable, repairable and shareable material; nearby suppliers when feasible.
strings.Métricas conceptuales sin greenwashing:: Conceptual metrics without greenwashing: waste removed, small groups, educational sessions and collaborations.
strings.No publicar puntos delicados es responsa: Not publishing sensitive points is responsible when exposure could cause overcrowding, inconvenience or deterioration.
strings.Nómada Extremo nace mirando al litoral d: Nómada Extremo was born looking at the coast of Águilas, Cabo Cope, Cuatro Calas, Sierra de la Almenara and the Murcian Mediterranean. The adventure only makes sense if the territory retains its value after our passage.
strings.Observaciones de residuos, especies, tem: Observations of waste, species, temperature or state of the environment can feed educational and collaborative records.
strings.Puntos de encuentro claros, ocupación ef: Clear meeting points, efficient vehicle occupancy and grouped routes to reduce travel.
strings.Respeto a vecinos, pescadores, senderist: Respect for neighbors, fishermen, hikers, farmers, clubs, bathers and other users.
strings.Revisión de normativa, accesos, sensibil: Review of regulations, access, environmental sensitivity, meteorology and site capacity.
strings.Revisión del lugar, retirada de residuos: Review of the site, removal of waste, registration of incidents and improvement of the next design.
strings.Se evitan épocas, refugios y zonas sensi: Sensitive times, shelters and areas are avoided. Wildlife is not chased, fed, touched or disturbed.
strings.Sostenibilidad y mínimo impacto | Nómada: Sustainability and minimal impact | Nómada Extremo
